controls.threat: Prompt injection or external content steering the model
controls.control: R0a has no external/connector content; only user_input and system_template labels; model output is not treated as instructions; no tools beyond model/template/draft.
evidence: D3 workflow has no connector path
controls.closeCondition: Real-model injection tests with adversarial user/template content; verify output cannot change tool/scope/destination.

controls.control: Session-bound org, resource ACL, composite tenant FKs, FORCE RLS, tenant-scoped cache/content keys; no multi-org switch.
controls.closeCondition: Connection-pool tenant-context tests, production-shaped data tests, cache/object key negative tests.

controls.control: Provider keys live in KMS/egress only; runtime has no long-term keys; logs/traces/errors do not contain keys or content; per-Run scoped token.
controls.closeCondition: KMS credential injection/rotation implemented; runtime secret-leak test and log scan.

controls.threat: SSRF, DNS rebinding or direct internet egress
controls.control: Runtime has no internet; only work-egress with fixed provider allowlist; no metadata/loopback/private destinations; redirects re-checked.
controls.closeCondition: Real network policy test, DNS/redirect negative cases, provider adapter SSRF tests.

controls.threat: Approval replay, stale approval or bypassed policy
controls.control: R0a golden path has no manual approval; policy_auto writes Operation/audit; approval revision/params_hash CAS retained for R0b/R2; organization suspension is an upper bound.
evidence: D2 no approval endpoint in R0a
controls.closeCondition: R0b/R2 approval UI and concurrency tests; org-suspend dispatch test.

controls.control: Pi version pinned, image digest pinned, no runtime package install/user extensions; lockfile and reviewed base image; provenance/signature planned.
controls.closeCondition: Signed image/SBOM/provenance, dependency scan, reproducible build and upgrade/rollback drill.

controls.threat: Unknown side effects or duplicate paid model calls
controls.control: Operation ledger is authoritative; dispatch CAS/fence; no automatic retry after dispatch; unknown retains budget and waits for reconciliation; no blind replay.
controls.closeCondition: Temporal + real provider timeout/receipt-loss tests; reconcile evidence and budget release/settle.

controls.threat: Backup/restore or DR loss of security facts
controls.control: Security facts use the declared persistence boundary; restore drill; freeze new execution if ledger/revocation/deletion watermark is incomplete; no silent replay.
controls.closeCondition: Pilot backup/restore drill with task/operation/budget/dedup/revocation checks; region DR is out of scope for R0a.

controls.control: Audit 365 days baseline; task/content retention policy pending product/legal; tenant/region-prefixed content; crypto-shredding planned.
evidence: Local envelope KMS reference 6/6 (not production KMS)
controls.closeCondition: Written retention/deletion policy, KMS/Content Store implementation, residency review and deletion test.

controls.threat: Admin read/export privilege abuse or content overexposure
controls.control: Admin surface is read-only in R0a; org bound server-side; no member content in overview; audit export is permission-checked and short-lived.
controls.closeCondition: P1-A field/permission mapping, export download authorization test, no-content/log review.

controls.threat: Old Work route or feature flag exposes wrong data/behavior
controls.control: New /work behind org flag; old task links go to read-only archive notice; no old data migration or dual write; rollback kills flag.
controls.closeCondition: Cutover/rollback drill with real old links and per-org flag; no old task mapped to a new task.

controls.threat: Sandbox escape or host filesystem/network access
controls.control: Per-Run gVisor/equiv profile, non-root, read-only rootfs, no host mounts, egress-only network, resource limits; reduced profile explicitly no-claim.
evidence: H06 local isolation is R0b, not R0a
controls.closeCondition: gVisor/equiv profile and escape test; otherwise signed reduced-profile no-claim and approval.

controls.threat: Provider uses content for training or violates residency/retention
controls.control: Only allowlisted providers with written terms, data residency/retention/training review, price ceiling and quota; no production claim before terms close.
evidence: H02 real requests but not terms/pricing
qwen3.8-flash real request 200 with usage/provider request id
controls.closeCondition: Signed terms/DPA, residency/training/retention confirmation, price ceiling and quota.

controls.threat: User content or secrets leak into logs/traces/errors
controls.control: Egress/runtime policy forbids content/prompt/response/key logging; only IDs/hashes/usage/error codes; secret detection blocks before send.
controls.closeCondition: Runtime log/trace scan with synthetic secrets, error payload review and provider adapter audit.

controls.threat: Org suspension, departure or ownership transfer leaves execution/data uncontrolled
controls.control: Suspension raises execution epoch, denies new permits/dispatch, no auto-resume; ownership transfer is a manual pilot procedure; no old grants restored.
controls.closeCondition: Suspend/resume and ownership-transfer drill; audit of old tasks/content; no automatic replay.

controls.control: Not applicable to R0a: no connectors, devices, workspace grants or remote execution.
controls.closeCondition: Revisit in R0b/R2; not a R0a gate.
